protocol.purpose: Validate the existing five-minute CHoCH candidate on locally unexamined earlier history before attempting improvements.
protocol.cases: 18 earlier cases (three baskets, three capitals, two paths), six uninterrupted extended $50k cases, four May-November 2026 $50k single-asset controls, six earlier $50k higher-cost resimulations; 34 total.
protocol.controls: Using original calendars, data and warmup, the May-November 2026 MCL controls must match the saved later_mcl_only shared-account trades and daily equities. MNQ controls compare the accelerated runner to a fresh original ClockPortfolio replay. No new performance claim is made from these reproduction controls.
protocol.rules: Unchanged two-left/two-right confirmed pivots, established HH/HL or LH/LL structure, structural stop, confirmed retest within three candles, immediate next-minute entry, 2R target, first eligible signal per NY/Asia session, at most two trades per asset/day, original missing-bucket reset and daily flatten. No additional filters, no target/stop search, no timeframe or universe ranking.
protocol.risk_and_capital: Inherit portfolio_protocol.json: 1% planned entry risk, 2% aggregate planned risk, two positions, 3% daily-loss budget, 80% capital utilization limit, full static initial-margin proxy. Use whole contracts. Gaps can exceed planned risk. These are historical planning proxies, not current broker quotes or reconstructed historical margin.
protocol.rolls: Match existing conventions: MNQ quarterly roll third Friday minus seven days at 18:00 New York; MCL roll seven calendar days before contract last_trade_date at 18:00 New York. Historical contract reference determines expiry; never volume or realized profits. Report explicitly tagged stale old-contract exits.
protocol.costs: Base $0.85 per side and one adverse market tick, unchanged. Higher-cost earlier $50k cases fully resimulate $1.50 per side and two ticks, including sizing and risk halts. Also retain the existing fixed-fill repricing for comparison.
protocol.history_status: Earlier history is unused locally by the five-minute strategy, but this hypothesis was selected from later history and the four-hour study examined overlapping dates. It is retrospective reverse-time validation, not a genuine untouched forward holdout or proof of future edge.
protocol.reporting: Publish all 34 cases, input/source hashes, monthly returns, net R, trade concentration, planned risk, capital rejections, path disagreement, cost stress and data gaps. Describe zero-trade small accounts explicitly. No live orders, purchases, or paper-configuration changes.
